title: Hinomori Shiho — Varied Kindness〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Don't Let Doubts Hold You Back

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Phew. The choir recital is finally over.
Now we can all focus on band practice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We'll need to have a discussion once everyone gets here...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're worried because you're afraid, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're afraid of being disliked by the people on whichever side you don't pick, no?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (MEIKO reassured me that Honami understood what I was trying to say but...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sigh... I probably should at least apologize to her.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami... Sorry, I didn't notice you there at all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It's okay, I just arrived.
May I sit with you?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, of course...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I hope she didn't hear me talking to myself just now...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho, you know...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Y-Yes...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think you're really cool.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So you don't have to apologize for anything.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(She did hear me...
But...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't want things to end like this, so I have to say it...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Honami...
For not being able to tell you in a nicer way.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Shiho...
It's okay. Don't worry about it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks... But I really want to be careful with what I say from now on.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. See? You're so cool.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You didn't have to apologize at all, you know.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It was your words that ultimately spurred me on to try harder in the end.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I also know you tend to sound harsh because you're usually the one who courageously speaks up about things that others have a hard time saying.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You always seem unconcerned, but you always point out the things we need to pay attention to when it matters...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: People find it hard to accept sometimes and I'm sure that causes a lot of pain for you as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But you wouldn't have said anything at all if you truly didn't care.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thanks to your words, I was able to overcome my weakness.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then I'm glad it turned out well...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've realized something because of all this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really? What?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You really need a lot of courage to express your opinion and stand by it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Of course, you'll still wonder if what you're saying is correct or that the other person may not understand what you're trying to say.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And there's also a real possibility that people may end up hating you because of that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... I know it's strange for me to be saying all this now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But you've always been so clear about what you wanted ever since we were little.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And that's why I think you're so cool!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: However, I don't think it's appropriate for me to just blurt out whatever comes to mind.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, um... I may still end up sounding a little harsh, but I'm gonna try to tone it down for sure.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I really love that part of you, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hah. Who are you, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, Saki and Ichika are late. Shall we start eating without them?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm famished...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: Shiho & Honami
rows.Line: Let's eat!
